description.value: Just Fold is a dessert café situated at Lonsdale Quay in North Vancouver, steps from the SeaBus terminal that connects to downtown Vancouver. Its waterfront commercial setting makes it a natural stop for cyclists arriving or departing via the SeaBus or riding the North Shore. The café's dessert focus offers a sweet refuelling option along one of the region's busiest cycling corridors.
